system.description: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose one option: perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell with a total MP cost equal to or lower than 10 (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.
